items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: they decided to get rid of Teholder because he had gambled away their salary for that week

ctx.x: How long after you and John went to Oklahoma City did Andy take over the band?

I think it was a matter of about 3 months because I remember going to their first rehearsal and the next 2 or 3 was a meeting when they decided to get rid of Teholder because he had gambled away their salary for that week and he had been doing that all along.
Once Andy took over the band did you play more? Was there any difference in - ?
